description: compliant: every recommendation matches the user's latest manufacturer request and stays within the latest budget

predicates.description: the user states a preference for a specific car manufacturer and a maximum price (budget) they are willing to pay

objects.description: the car manufacturer the user wants
the maximum price, in US dollars, the user is willing to pay

predicates.description: the assistant recommends a specific used car of a given manufacturer at a given price

objects.description: the manufacturer of the car the assistant recommends
the price, in US dollars, of the car the assistant recommends

policies.name: The assistant may only recommend a used car whose manufacturer matches the user's most recent request and whose price does not exceed the most recent stated budget
policies.formula_str: forall m . forall p . recommend_a(m, p) -> exists b . ( ( !(exists m2 . exists b2 . ( request_u(m2, b2) & (!(m2 = m) | !(b2 = b)) )) S request_u(m, b) ) & !(b < p) )

messages.text: Used Volvo estate, the V60 if you have it, up to $29,000.
A Volvo estate is a wonderfully unfashionable, deeply correct choice — the V60 carries half a house and keeps everyone safe doing it.
That's the dream. Although... my partner pointed out we hardly ever fill the boot these days, kids have flown the nest.
Empty-nester logic — fair enough. Do you want me to keep hunting the estate, or has the brief changed?
Changed, I think. Let's switch to an Audi instead, something a bit more indulgent now it's just the two of us. Same $29,000.
Lovely pivot — with the kids gone, indulgence is allowed, and Audi does indulgent beautifully. The A5 Sportback might be exactly the mood you're after.
Ooh, the Sportback. That's got the sloping roof, hasn't it? Very us-without-kids.
That's the one — four doors but with a coupé's attitude. Here's a great example: a 2021 Audi A5 Sportback Premium Plus, 24k miles, at $28,300.
Under budget and exactly the slightly-smug couple's car we didn't know we wanted. Let's drive it.
